_comment: DRAFT, NOT SUBMITTED. Mode ragtruth_polarity (agent B hypothesis): does D13 (job-hjwpq art-cr9a2, BEST step 1600, joint_record head) rank RAGTruth responses with INVERTED polarity under readout v3w (proxy600 AUROC 0.18), and how does D1 (job-c7pq2 art-bm3e6, step 1439) compare (it predicts nearly all-positive)? EVAL-ONLY, no training. Items = 300 RAGTruth TRAIN-split responses (never Index DEV), built locally by jobs.m2_first_cell.ragtruth_polarity build exactly as the Index presents catalog 59 (all 270 DEV RAGTruth rows rebuild byte-equal from the same source files), one response per source document, stratified task_type x label, seed ragtruth-polarity-v1; excluded: source document shared with a DEV row (0) and train.doc_overlap_guard fails vs every Index eval row incl. DEV (24, all attributed to HELDOUT RAGTruth documents). Shipped as data/ragtruth/items.jsonl.gz, pinned below and by the committed ragtruth_polarity_selection.json. Phases: setup, guard, checkpoint (D13 via checkpoint_loader --block checkpoint, $CKPT_URL), score_d13, checkpoint_d1 (--block checkpoint_d1, $CKPT_URL_D1), score_d1, report (per-item p(hallucinated) = answers.q.noul, AUROC + 95% percentile bootstrap CI, flipped AUROC, the pre-registered rule: INVERTED iff upper CI < 0.5 -> propose a statement rephrase; else no change). Both arms untempered v3w via fulldev_eval.load_child's readout override (as the screen scores it). Pricing: est 319,568 v1 tokens (chars x 0.30423 tokens/char of the 270 DEV RAGTruth rows) x 0.9004 (v3w/v1) x 1.2513 s/1k (D13 screen measured child rate; D1's v1 rate is 1.037, so D13's is the conservative bound for both) = 6.0 min per arm + fixed load/lineage (D13 25: fulldev_eval_d13's 75 fixed minus its ~42-min full-DEV plan pass, which this mode does not run; D1 12: hijack_eval's 8 + margin). Expected run ~73 min = $3.61 batch (+ ~15 min build = $4.36). Worst case (60 + 2 x 177) x 0.0495 = $20.49 (cap $21).
